name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy, with links back to each level.

examples.name: breadcrumbs-demo
examples.title: Breadcrumbs
examples.description: A three-level trail; the last item is the current page.

examples.name: breadcrumbs-collapsed
examples.title: Collapsed
examples.description: maxItems folds the middle of a long trail into an ellipsis button that expands it.

examples.name: breadcrumbs-with-icon
examples.title: With an icon
examples.description: Icons in children are sized to the text.

props.name: children
props.description: Breadcrumb elements, root first. The last one is the current page.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse when there are more items: keeps the first and the last maxItems − 1, with an ellipsis button between.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the navigation landmark and the list. Must be unique on a page — name each trail if a page has more than one.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the ellipsis button.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when an item is pressed (for client-side routing without hrefs).

props.name: href
props.description: Link target. Ignored on the last (current) item.

props.name: linkProps
props.description: Extra props for the inner link, e.g. target or routerOptions.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the link when it mounts.

keyboard.action: Moves between links; the current page is not a tab stop.
Follows the focused link, or expands a collapsed trail from the ellipsis button (focus moves to the first revealed link).

notes: Renders <nav aria-label="Breadcrumbs"> around an <ol> with the same name. Landmark names must be unique: pass aria-label when a page shows more than one trail.
The last item has aria-current="page" and is not a link; it is set in medium weight so it doesn't rely on colour.
Chevron separators are decorative (aria-hidden) and mirror in right-to-left layouts.

do: Start at the top level of the product and end at the current page.
Use the page titles people see in headings.
Collapse trails deeper than about four levels with maxItems.
dont: Don't use breadcrumbs for steps in a flow — use Steps.
Don't make the current page a link.
Don't use them as the only navigation on a page.
